t: An ESP32 audio board with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, microphones and speaker outputs.
steps: Look for a leftover board at a distributor such as DigiKey, or pick the ESP32-LyraT-Mini.
Install ESP-IDF and ESP-ADF from Espressif on your computer.
Select the LyraT V4.3 board in the menuconfig settings.
Fit jumpers JP23 to JP25 to allow automatic uploads.
Plug a micro USB cable into the UART port.
Build and flash the play MP3 example from ESP-ADF.
Plug in headphones or speakers and listen.
Remove the upload jumpers after flashing.
meta: Open Board. From $50. A few stores.
